artworks.title: Christ on the Mount of Olives
artworks.description: The image shows a man kneeling with his body turned slightly to the left. He has long, wavy hair and a beard. His hands are clasped together in front of him. The man is dressed in loose robes. Around him, the land is rocky with scattered vegetation. Behind him to the left, there are two other figures with trees and a path leading into the landscape. In the sky above him, there is a head with flowing hair surrounded by clouds and emanating rays of light toward the man. The background includes a large tree, clouds, and atmospheric details, creating a dramatic setting.

artworks.title: Abduction on a Unicorn
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 30.7 × 20.9 cm (12 1/16 × 8 1/4 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of mythological creatures in a dynamic scene. A centaur is depicted engaging with a unicorn. The background consists of swirling clouds and a rugged landscape. The drawing includes intricate details showing the textures and forms of the creatures. The style resembles an old master's engraving style.

artworks.title: The Sudarium Held by One Angel
artworks.description: The image shows a detailed line drawing of angelic beings in a celestial scene. Central figure appears with flowing garments and wings, holding a cloth or scroll. Smaller figures below engage in various activities amidst swirling clouds and dramatic sky. The intricate line work reflects early 16th-century woodcut or engraving techniques, emphasizing texture and depth through hatching and cross-hatching.

artworks.title: The Virgin and Child on a Crescent with a Sceptre and a Starry Crown
artworks.description: The image depicts a woman holding a child. The woman has a gentle tilt to her head and appears to be looking at the child. She has detailed facial features, long flowing hair, and wears a crown. Her clothing is adorned with draped fabric. The child is naked and appears to be looking outward, resting in the woman's left arm. The woman holds a staff in her right hand. Radiating lines create a halo effect in the background. The number "1516" is inscribed to the right, and an artist's monogram is at the bottom right.

artworks.title: The Virgin and Child Crowned by Two Angels
artworks.description: The image depicts a woman seated on a stone holding a child in her lap. The woman has delicate features, long flowing hair, and a serene expression. She wears a detailed gown. The child has curly hair and is dressed in simple clothing. Two winged angels hover above, holding crowns. In the background, there is a rustic fence, hills, and trees. An object with inscriptions is near the woman's feet. The scene conveys tranquility and reverence.

artworks.title: The Crucifixion called the Sword Pommel of Maximilian
artworks.dimensions: sheet (diameter; trimmed to platemark): 3.81 cm (1 1/2 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a crucifixion scene. The drawing includes a man on a cross at the center, surrounded by several figures with halos around their heads. The central figure has a cloth around the waist, arms outstretched on the beam of the cross, and head tilted downwards. Below the cross is a skull and crossbones symbol. Additional figures on both sides of the cross have different expressions and gestures, possibly engaged in mourning or contemplation. The artwork is set within a circular border, reminiscent of a medallion. The figures' attire and shading demonstrate a high level of technical skill typical of print or engraving art often associated with the Renaissance period.

artworks.title: The Crucifixion called the Sword Pommel of Maxmilian
artworks.artist: Hieronymus Wierix and Antonie Wierix after Albrecht Dürer
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a crucifixion scene. The image depicts a central figure on a cross, surrounded by rays of light emanating from the circular boundary. Flanking the central figure are individuals adorned in draped garments, standing solemnly on either side. One of the figures at the base of the cross seems to be supporting the central figure. The composition is detailed, with elements like a skull on the ground and intricate folds of fabric enhancing the depth and contrast of the black and white illustration. The setting is composed within a circular frame.

artworks.title: The Virgin Nursing the Child
artworks.description: The image shows a seated figure of a woman with a child in her arms. The woman has soft facial features and styled hair under a draped head covering, wearing detailed clothing with fur trims. She is surrounded by light rays emanating from a halo. The child, with curled hair, looks up at the woman. They are both clad in fabric. The background has fine lines radiating outward, with an artist's monogram and a dated plaque at the base.

artworks.title: Peasant Couple at Market
artworks.description: The image shows two individuals standing side by side. On the left is an older woman hunched slightly forward, holding onto the arm of the man next to her. She wears a headscarf, layered garments, and is next to a basket and a jug with a rooster. The man on the right stands upright with short wavy hair, a beard, and wears a tunic, belt, leggings, and boots. The background features a simple landscape and a structure in the distance. The image is an engraving with the date "1519" at the top and a monogram "AD" near the man's feet.

artworks.title: Saint Anthony Reading
artworks.description: The image shows a city with multiple towers and buildings, as seen from a raised perspective. In the foreground, a figure is sitting and reading, with a staff by their side. The city sprawls in intricate detail in the background, with towers and rooftops suggesting an old medieval town. The etching technique creates detailed lines, textures, and shadows. The monochromatic palette accentuates the details and gives the image a historical appearance.

artworks.title: Cardinal Albrecht of Brandenburg ("Small Cardinal")
artworks.description: The image shows an upper-body portrait of a man with a neutral expression. He has distinct facial features and wavy, shoulder-length hair covered by a cap. He wears a buttoned garment with a high collar, possibly a robe. In the background, there is a coat of arms with a double-headed eagle and other symbols. Latin text surrounds the portrait. The setting appears formal and suggests a sense of dignity.

artworks.title: The Virgin with the Swaddled Child
artworks.description: This print depicts a woman seated on a cushion with a baby in her arms. Her face is turned downwards towards the child she holds. The woman has light skin, closed eyes, small lips, long, wavy hair, and a round chin. She wears a long-sleeved garment with ruffled cuffs and a fur neckline with a large gem at the center. The baby also has light skin and light, curly hair. It is swaddled in a cloth, resting peacefully. Both the woman and child have rays of light emanating from around their heads; the rays around the woman are in a circular, halo-like shape, while those around the child are in three triangular bursts.  In the background, far below them, there are buildings, rolling hills, and a flat body of water. The woman sits on a cushion with tassels on top of a square block, and a stone with the date "1520" is visible in the bottom left corner.

artworks.title: The Virgin and Child Crowned by One Angel
artworks.description: The image shows a seated woman holding a child on her lap. The woman sits upright, with her head slightly tilted towards the child. She has long, flowing hair and wears a long draped garment. The child is also seated, with curly hair and wearing a ruffled outfit. Both have a halo around their heads. An angel with wings is depicted above them, holding a crown over the woman's head. In the background, there is a detailed landscape with buildings, trees, and a river. A wooden structure is partially visible, and the date "1520" and a monogram are engraved at the bottom left corner.

artworks.title: Saint Christopher Facing Left
artworks.description: The image shows an older bearded man carrying a child on his shoulder and walking through water. The man is holding a staff in his right hand and looking up at the child. The child has short hair and is holding onto the man's head with both hands. The man's clothing is draped in a robe, and the child wears a simple garment. In the background, there are trees, hills, and a small structure to the right. The water creates ripples around the man's legs, and there is a stone with an inscription in the water. The sky appears to be glowing, particularly around the child's head.

artworks.title: Saint Simon
artworks.description: This image shows an illustration of a man standing with his body facing slightly to the right and his head turned to the left. He has a long beard, is bald on top, and has long hair at the sides and back. The man has a serious expression, deep-set eyes, prominent cheekbones, and is dressed in a robe with a mantle draped over his shoulders, detailed with linear patterns. He is holding a large sword with a serrated edge in both hands in front of his body. The background is plain with a date, "1523," and a monogram in the lower right corner of the image. The illustration is in monochrome.

artworks.title: Cardinal Albrecht of Brandenburg ("Large Cardinal")
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 16.9 x 12.6 cm (6 5/8 x 4 15/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image displays a side profile portrait of a person, focusing on the upper half of their body. The person has a prominent nose, full lips, and a defined chin, with wavy, short hair visible underneath a large beret-style hat. They are wearing a high-collared garment. To the right of the person is a coat of arms featuring various heraldic symbols, and the background has a textured surface with Latin text above and below the portrait.

artworks.title: Frederick the Wise, Elector of Saxony
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 19.2 x 12.7 cm (7 9/16 x 5 in.)

artworks.title: Philip Melanchthon
artworks.description: This print is a portrait of a man, seen from the chest up, looking to the right. He has pale skin, sharp cheekbones, a prominent brow, a slightly curved nose, lips set in a slight smile, a beard, and a mustache. The man's hair is medium length and appears wavy, with slight recession at the temples. He wears a collared garment under a loose jacket with visible stitching along the edges. The background is mostly blank at the top with some thin vertical lines that faintly suggest a dark sky with clouds. Below the portrait, there is an inscription in Latin along with the number 1526.

artworks.title: Saint Philip
artworks.description: The image shows a man in profile, holding a staff with a cross at the top. He is wearing a long tunic, with curly hair and a beard. The background has textured detail. A plaque with inscriptions is next to his foot.

artworks.title: Erasmus of Rotterdam
artworks.description: Created with fine black lines printed on cream-white paper, this vertical engraving shows a man facing our left, wearing a cap and voluminous robe as he writes on a sheet of paper. Closest to us and along the bottom edge of the composition, a table or shelf is spread with several books, some upright, some on their sides, and one thick tome laid open. The open book has writing on the pages, but the words are not legible. Beyond the books, the man is shown from the waist up with his body angled to our left. A few curls peek out from the soft, rounded cap that covers his head down to his neck and his forehead, and nearly reaches the top edge of the paper. His face and jowls are deeply lined, and he has deep-set eyes, a long, sloped nose, and his lips are closed. His robe rides high on his shoulders and around his neck, parting at the throat to show a high-collared garment beneath. He gazes down at his hands, which rest on the paper on which he writes. One thick-fingered hand holds the inkwell and the other the pen. The paper and a book underneath it rest on a lectern that angles up toward the writer. The lectern sits on a desk that also holds a short urn with a small bunch of leaves and flowers at the front corner closest to us. Two packets or pieces of folded paper sit next to the lectern.  Densely spaced, fine lines create dark shadows in the deep folds of the man’s garments and on the wall behind him. A panel on the wall behind the man reads, in Latin, “IMAGO ERASMI ROTERODA MI AB ALBERTO DVRERO AD VIVAM EFFIGIEM DELINIATA,” which is followed by a Greek inscription, and then, “MDXXXVI.” The artist signed the work with his monogram, consisting of an upper case D straddled by the legs of a wide, upper case A at the bottom center of the panel.

artworks.title: Witch Riding on a Goat
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 11.4 x 7 cm (4 1/2 x 2 3/4 in.)
artworks.description: This print shows a nude woman riding backwards on a large flying goat. The goat faces the right and has its front legs outstretched, while the woman faces the left and has one arm out behind her to grab one of the goat's horns. Her long hair flows out behind her, and her face appears wrinkled. She has a long cloth draped around her right elbow, and in that hand she holds a tall object with a bundle at the top. Below her and the goat, several cherubic figures stand or lay on the ground. They are nude and have small wings. Two stand and hold objects, including a potted plant and a circular object that looks like a large jug or beehive. Closer to us, two of the cherubs are on the ground, one bowing down and one laying with an arm outstretched. The ground they are on appears sandy, with small rocks and sparse patches of grass. Behind the group is a body of water or flat plain. The sky behind the woman on the goat is blank, except for some rays that appear in the top left corner of the print.

artworks.title: The Nativity
artworks.description: The image features an elevated view showing the interior of a rustic structure and an open courtyard. The horizon is obstructed by architectural elements and trees surrounding the area. Detailed linework with cross-hatching techniques is used, creating texture and depth. The color scheme is monochromatic, focusing on black and brown tones against a tan background. Two figures are shown on the left, engaged in an activity, while in the distance, through an archway, trees and a small building or natural element are visible.

artworks.title: Small Horse
artworks.description: This print shows a knight and a horse in an archway. The white horse is in profile, facing the left, with one front leg raised and its lips slightly parted. It has a curly mane and a long tail tied in a knot. Behind the horse is a knight in armor. His back is to us, and he holds a long axe-like weapon. The knight's face is mostly obscured by what appears to be a large helmet shaped like a moth or other bug with large wings. The background includes a stone archway, showing a glimpse of the sky and a wall with a bowl or urn that appears to be emitting smoke. Above the bowl is the date "1505."

artworks.title: The Virgin and Child on a Crescent with a Diadem
artworks.description: This print shows a woman holding an infant in her arms. The woman has a gentle expression as she looks down at the child. She is dressed in draped robes and there is a thin circlet around her head. Her light hair is long and curled. The infant in her arms is looking towards us and appears to be holding a small ball. Lines radiate from the two people, creating a halo around the woman's head. She stands on a crescent shape, with its curved edges pointing upwards.
